facts.claim: Star Breeze (Windstar Cruises): Entered service 1989; 42,000 GT; 312 guests (lower berth / double occupancy); 242 m length; Star Plus class.
Star Breeze is a German-built cruise ship completed in 1989.
The luxury liner travels between Europe and Africa, and is owned by Windstar Cruises.
In April 2015, she departed the Seabourn fleet, and on 6 May 2015 she was rechristened and entered service with Windstar Cruises.
